item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"claim_1","claim_type":"core","weight":28,"statement":"`Module.__call__` only starts a new usage tracker when `settings.track_usage` is enabled and the thread-local overrides do not already contain a `usage_tracker`; it wraps `forward`, collects total tokens from that tracker, and attaches them to the returned output before returning.","span_ids":["span_module_call","span_set_usage"]},{"claim_id":"claim_2","claim_type":"core","weight":24,"statement":"`Module.acall` implements the same guarded per-invocation usage tracking for async calls: it checks the thread-local override, wraps `aforward` in `track_usage`, collects total tokens, and attaches them to the async result before returning.","span_ids":["span_module_acall","span_set_usage"]},{"claim_id":"claim_3","claim_type":"core","weight":18,"statement":"LM usage is attached to the returned prediction object by `_set_lm_usage`, including when the module returns either a `Prediction` directly or a tuple whose first element is a `Prediction`.","span_ids":["span_set_usage"]},{"claim_id":"claim_4","claim_type":"core","weight":18,"statement":"The threaded parallel test exercises concurrent calls through `dspy.Parallel` with an added sleep to expose races, and it asserts that each returned result independently records `total_tokens == 10`.","span_ids":["span_test_parallel"]},{"claim_id":"claim_5","claim_type":"supporting","weight":12,"statement":"The async concurrency test runs multiple `program.acall(...)` coroutines with `asyncio.gather` after inserting an async delay, and it asserts that every gathered result keeps its own `total_tokens == 10`.","span_ids":["span_test_async"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"span_module_call","path":"dspy/primitives/module.py","start_line":93,"end_line":110},{"span_id":"span_module_acall","path":"dspy/primitives/module.py","start_line":112,"end_line":129},{"span_id":"span_set_usage","path":"dspy/primitives/module.py","start_line":319,"end_line":332},{"span_id":"span_test_parallel","path":"tests/predict/test_predict.py","start_line":742,"end_line":767},{"span_id":"span_test_async","path":"tests/predict/test_predict.py","start_line":770,"end_line":802}]}
